name: roblox-devforum
description: Full Roblox developer context for AI agents — DevForum search, API reference, Creator Hub docs, Luau stdlib, Creator Store, and platform status. 7 tools, 8 resources, 4 prompts.
long_description:
MCP server that gives AI agents complete context on the Roblox developer ecosystem.

**7 tools:**
- `forum_search` — Search DevForum with filters (solved, bugs, category, tag, period, sort, user)
- `forum_thread` — Read threads, accepted answers, and paginated replies
- `forum_taxonomy` — Browse categories, tags, category metadata
- `roblox_api` — Live Full-API-Dump: classes, members, enums, hierarchy
- `roblox_docs` — Creator Hub guides, Luau stdlib, community tutorials
- `platform_status` — Roblox service health and active incidents
- `creator_store` — Search the catalog (models, audio, plugins, meshes, decals, animations, badges)

**8 resource URIs** with completions for class/enum names.
**4 prompts** for guided workflows: research, debugging, implementation patterns, deprecation audits.

No API keys required.
